news.body: The Ravens D/ST surrendered only one touchdown while allowing 367 yards of offense in Sunday's 30-23 OT win against the Falcons.
news.head: Ravens defense come up with three sacks, one pick Sunday night
news.impact: The Falcons had a defensive score in Sunday night's contest, so the Ravens defense actually gave up fewer than 20 points in the overtime victory. The unit ended the game with a clutch interception and recorded three sacks over the course of the contest. The Ravens should be a popular play against the Browns in Week 6.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 222 passing yards, 85 rushing yards, and 18 points in a win over the Titans.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 18 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. The Titans' offense was finally able to start breaking through in the second half, but the game appeared well in hand at that point. The Ravens will travel to Atlanta in Week 5.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 31 points while picking up one sack and forcing one turnover in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: Baltimore's defense struggled to keep up with an excellent Dallas offense in this high-scoring matchup. They managed to recover one fumble while getting a sack from Roquan Smith in the win. They will be a top fantasy option in Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 24 pints, 252 yards passing, and 65 rushing yards in the loss to the Saints.
news.head: Ravens D/ST struggles in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied three sacks but failed to force a turnover in the loss. The Ravens will need to get some of the issues with the pass defense together before taking on Dak Prescott and the Cowboys in Week 3.

news.body: The Bills D/ST allowed 34 points while picking up one sack in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 34 points in OT win in Week 5
news.impact: Buffalo's defense struggled to slow the Rams in the game, although they toughened up in overtime, holding LA scoreless. The Bills will look for a better fantasy performance in Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: The Bills D/ST allowed 269 passing yards, 143 rushing yards, and 29 points in the loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 29 points in Week 4 loss
news.impact: The Bills' defense tallied one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss Sunday. Despite the two turnovers, the Bills could not stop a late comeback by Drake Maye in the Patriots. The Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: The Bills D/ST registered two sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
news.head: Bills D/ST quiet in Week 3
news.impact: The defense made up for a surprising five giveaways by their offense, allowing just one touchdown in a winning effort. The unit will look to take advantage of a New England Patriots offense with turnover issues of their own in Week 4.

news.body: The Bills' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 31 points in Thursday night's win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 31 points in win Thursday
news.impact: Buffalo's defense looked good at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they weren't able to sustain that energy throughout and ended up allowing 31 points over the course of the night. This unit has some talent but will have a tough schedule coming up for the next three weeks at least, so fantasy managers shouldn't put much trust in them at this point in the season.

news.body: The Panthers defense surrendered 26 points on 452 yards offense, recording one sack in Sunday night's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Panthers D/ST allows 26 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: The Panthers gave up more than 400 yards through the air Sunday night, but they limited the Lions to only two touchdowns, playing an extreme version of bend-don't-break defense. The Carolina unit did a nice job of slowing down running back Jahmyr Gibbs, and that was pivotal to the victory. Still, there was not much here in terms of fantasy value. The Panthers will now enter their bye before traveling to Philadelphia in Week 6.

news.body: The Panthers' D/ST logged two sacks and a fumble recovery while allowing 21 points in Sunday's loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Panthers D/ST allows 21 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Carolina's defense was able to log a few big plays on Sunday, but they ended up allowing 21 points and suffering a loss at the hands of the Browns. This unit should not be rostered at this point, especially with a tough matchup against the Lions coming down the pipe for next week.

news.body: The Carolina Panthers D/ST had a big day against the Atlanta Falcons, holding them to just three points in the 34-3 victory, racking up two fumble recoveries, three interceptions, including a pick-six, and three sacks.
news.head: Carolina Panthers D/ST bounce back in big win over Atlanta
news.impact: The Falcons' QB situation has been dire the last two weeks between Cooper Rush and Jack Strand, and the Panthers' took full advantage. They'll get another potentially easy matchup against Cleveland next week, but the Browns bounced back in their own way after their season-opening loss to Jacksonville.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST forced one turnover (one fumble recovery) while also recording two sacks in a 59-37 Week 1 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Panthers D/ST dismal in Week 1 loss
news.impact: The unit did not have many answers for an explosive Chicago offense in the season opener, allowing eight total touchdowns on 592 offensive yards, with six of those scores coming on the ground in the loss. The unit will look to get back on track against an Atlanta Falcons offense that could be forced to once again start quarterback Cooper Rush in Week 2.

news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded five sacks while also forcing three turnovers (three fumble recoveries) in a 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
news.head: Bears D/ST records five sacks in Week 6
news.impact: The defense was able to keep the Atlanta offense mostly in check, allowing 257 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 31-7 loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 5.
news.head: Bears D/ST struggles in Week 5
news.impact: The defense struggled to slow down a surprisingly explosive Green Bay offense, allowing 428 offensive yards as well as multiple touchdowns on the ground and through the air. The unit will look to get back on track against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.

news.body: The Bears D/ST allowed 12 points while notching three sacks in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Bears D/ST turns in strong performance in Week 4 win
news.impact: Chicago's defense turned in an excellent performance for the second straight week. They got sacks from Devin Bush, Dayo Odeyingbo, and Austin Booker in the win. Chicago will now prepare to take on the Packers in Week 5.

news.body: The Bears D/ST allowed seven points while forcing three turnovers and notching two sacks in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
news.head: Bears D/ST excellent in Week 3 win
news.impact: Chicago's defense came to play in Week 3's Monday night game. They made things tough on the Philly offense, intercepting two passes and recovering a Tank Bigsby fumble. They will look to keep it going in Week 4 against the Jets.

news.body: The Browns D/ST allowed 17 points while picking up four sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 17-12 loss to the Jets in Week 5.
news.head: Browns D/ST notches four sacks in Week 5
news.impact: Cleveland's defense played well on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. They got a strip-sack on Geno Smith in the fourth quarter while also recovering a Kenyon Sadiq fumble. The Browns will now take on the Ravens at home in Week 6.

news.body: The Browns" D/ST gave up 24 points on 361 yards of total offense, coming up with two sacks and two interceptions in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Browns defense comes up with two picks in Thursday's win
news.impact: The Browns largely shut the Steelers' offense down through the first three quarters Thursday night, allowing just 10 points. The Steelers rallied for a fourth-quarter comeback behind QB Aaron Rodgers before Browns kicker Andre Szmyt nailed a 56-yard, game-winning field goal with 10 seconds remaining. Still, the Browns defense turned in a fairly solid effort, and the unit has played well during a surprising three-game winning streak. An inviting matchup with the Jets awaits in Week 5.

news.body: The Browns' D/ST logged three sacks and an interception while allowing 18 points in Sunday's win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Browns D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cleveland's defense did well on Sunday, holding Carolina's offense to just 18 points over the course of the afternoon. They were also able to log several big plays to help out the offense, which played a big hand in their eventual win.

news.body: The Browns D/ST allowed 19 points on 313 total yards with one interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Browns D/ST keeps Buccaneers offense in check
news.impact: The Browns defense was able to help lead the team to an upset win over Tampa Bay. They'll face Bryce Young and the Panthers next week.

news.body: The Denver Broncos D/ST racked up five sacks, two interceptions, and a fumble recovery in the team's 17-14 OT win over Seattle on Thursday.
news.head: Denver Broncos D/ST rack up turnovers in win
news.impact: Denver's defense put the clamps on Seattle's offense, allowing only a single touchdown all game and a pair of field goals. The offense didn't do them many favors in sustaining drives and putting up points to give the defense a bit of breathing room, but it didn't matter. Denver's D looks like they've found their groove and will be an elite unit once again.

news.body: The Broncos D/ST gave up 17 points on only 237 yards of total offense, racking up five sacks and forcing three turnovers in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Broncos defense delivers strong performance in Week 5 win
news.impact: The Broncos came out the victors in this defensive battle on Sunday. One week after failing to record a single sack in a loss at San Francisco, the Denver pass rush dialed things up and battered Chargers QB Justin Herbert in this one. The Broncos also came up with a pair of fumble recoveries and an interception on the afternoon. They are a solid unit, but a difficult matchup with the Seahawks awaits the Broncos in Week 6.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST failed to record a sack or turnover while allowing 24 points in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
news.head: Broncos D/ST held without sack in loss Sunday
news.impact: Denver's defense held San Francisco to three points in the first half, but couldn't make enough impact plays after halftime. The Broncos' defense finished without a sack or a takeaway as the 49ers' offense scored three second-half touchdowns. That said, the Broncos get a much better matchup in Week 5 against the winless Los Angeles Chargers -- who turned the ball over three times in Sunday's loss to the Seattle Seahawks. The Broncos' defense remains a strong fantasy option in that matchup.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged four sacks, two interceptions, and a touchdown while allowing 26 points in Sunday night's win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: Denver's defense allowed the Rams' offense to move the ball on Sunday night, but they logged several big plays to help change the course of the game, including a pick-six at one crucial point. This unit is one of the NFL's finest but will have their work cut out for them in a matchup against San Francisco's red-hot offense in Week 4.

news.body: The Packers D/ST registered four sacks while also forcing five turnovers (three interceptions, two fumble recoveries) in a 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Packers D/ST wreaks havoc in Week 5 win
news.impact: The defense took advantage of a Chicago offense forced into using Tyson Bagent and Case Keenum behind center, holding the offense to 246 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to slow down an explosive Dallas Cowboys offense in Week 6.

news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 14 points while picking up three sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 17-14 win over Tampa in Week 4.
news.head: Packers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: Green Bay's defense benefited from Tampa being forced to start undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels in the contest. They picked him off twice while sacking him three times. Green Bay will have a much tougher challenge in Week 5 when they face the Bears.

news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed an early interception before going quiet on the box score for the rest of the game in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST run over by Atlanta in loss
news.impact: The Packers pulled off a pick four plays into the game, but didn't put anything else on the stat sheet afterwards. It was a dominant outing by the Falcons offense, with the Packers defense unable to stop Drake London or the ground game led by Bijan and Brian Robinson, who collectively averaged 5.9 yards per carry on the night. They'll look to be better next time out.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks in a 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
news.head: Packers D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 2 win
news.impact: The unit made stops when it mattered to carry an inconsistent Green Bay offense, allowing 285 offensive yards in the win. The defense will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Atlanta Falcons offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 306 passing yards, 106 rushing yards, and 31 points in a win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 31 points in Week 6 win
news.impact: The Texans' defense forced one interception, but tallied no sacks against Trevor Lawrence and the Jaguars. The Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 3 points on 187 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Titans.
news.head: Texans D/ST dominates Sunday
news.impact: The Texans defense looked at their best of the season on Sunday. They'll take on Trevor Lawrence and Jacksonville next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 34 points on 399 total yards with three sacks Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: Houston had a chance to win its first game of the season with one defensive stop, but they weren't able to get it done. They'll look to bounce back against the Titans next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 19 points, 235 passing yards, and 89 rushing yards in a loss to the Colts Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 19 points in Week 3
news.impact: Houston's defense did a great job of keeping Jonathan Taylor in check, but allowed Daniel Jones to perform well enough to send the Texans to 0-3. The Texans will face Dallas in a tough matchup in Week 4.

news.body: The Indianapolis Colts D/ST posted an interception in the team's 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. They didn't put up anything else in the box score.
news.head: Indianapolis Colts D/ST posts interception in loss
news.impact: The Colts continue to get run over by other teams, if you can call what the Titans did to them "running over." It was more the Titans' defense doing the damage than their offense, but it doesn't help that the Colts can't seem to generate sacks and takeaways consistently. They are not worth streaming right now in fantasy.

news.body: The Indianapolis Colts D/ST managed a single sack in the team's 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Indianapolis Colts D/ST manage single sack in loss
news.impact: Indy once again struggled to make any sort of stop on defense, with the Steelers largely slicing their way through on the ground and in the air. It was yet another poor performance for this defense that has more talent on it than the performance implies; it's just a matter of getting that talent to start playing like it.

news.body: The Colts D/ST allowed 217 passing yards, 100 rushing yards, and 13 points in a win over the Commanders Sunday.
news.head: Colts D/ST allows 13 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: The Colts' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in the win. The team faced an easier matchup once the Commanders were forced to turn to Athan Kaliakmanis with Marcus Mariota suffering a knee injury early. The Colts will take on the Steelers in Week 5.

news.body: The Colts D/ST allowed 17 points, 167 passing yards, and 70 rushing yards in a 19-17 win over Houston.
news.head: Colts D/ST allows 17 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Colts defense tallied three sacks in the win over Houston Sunday. They dominated the trenches, holding the Texans' to just 3.3 yards per carry on 21 attempts. The Colts will look to build on the win against the Commanders in Week 4.

news.body: The Jaguars D/ST allowed 312 passing yards, 114 rushing yards, and 34 points in a loss to Houston.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST allows 34 points in Week 6 loss
news.impact: The Jaguars' defense tallied one interception, but failed to record a sack. The defense has been solid all season and will look to regroup in their bye week before taking on the Colts in Week 8.

news.body: The Jaguars defense allowed only 17 points on 232 yards of offense, coming up with one sack in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST allows just 17 points to depleted Eagles
news.impact: The Jaguars defense is one of the best in the league at shutting down the run. The unit lived up to that billing in Week 5, limiting the Eagles to only 22 yards on 18 rushing attempts. The Jaguars were also pretty solid against the pass, giving up 220 yards on 40 passes, 62 of which came on one big play. The Jaguars were facing a beaten-up Eagles offense, but it was still a strong effort. The Jaguars are allowing only 14.0 points per game and have yet to give up more than 20 in any of the first five weeks of the season.

news.body: The Jaguars' D/ST logged two sacks and two interceptions while allowing just 17 points in Sunday's win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST logs two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: Jacksonville's defense had a great performance on Sunday. They held the Bengals to just 17 points over the course of the afternoon, and they were able to log several big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started for the foreseeable future, however, as they have more tough matchups coming down the pipe very soon.

news.body: The Jaguars' D/ST logged three sacks, two interceptions, and one fumble recovery while allowing just six points in Sunday's blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST stellar in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Jacksonville's defense absolutely shut down the Patriots' offense on Sunday. They allowed just six points over the course of the afternoon and were able to log a number of big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a tough matchup coming up against the Bengals next week, however, so they may not be worth starting despite their great performance this week.

news.body: The Kansas City Chiefs' defense allowed six points while recording four sacks and an interception in a 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST Dominates Chargers in Week 6
news.impact: Kansas City kept Los Angeles out of the end zone and limited Justin Herbert to 204 passing yards while sacking him four times. The Chargers also went 0 for 3 on fourth down. Kansas City's defense continues to give fantasy managers a combination of scoring prevention and turnover upside and remains a strong starting option heading into next week.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 27 points while forcing two turnovers in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 27 points in Week 4
news.impact: Kansas City struggled to slow down the Raiders on offense but they managed to hold on in the close win. They intercepted Kirk Cousins once and recovered a Dareke Young fumble in the game. Kansas City will be on bye in Week 5 before a Week 6 matchup against the Chargers.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST records four sacks in Week 3
news.impact: The defense made stops when it needed to, allowing just one touchdown despite giving up 329 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for more impactful plays against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 4.

news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 30 points in Sunday night's overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST struggles in win Sunday
news.impact: Kansas City's defense didn't look good on Sunday night. They allowed Indianapolis to put up 30 points, and they weren't able to log a single sack or turnover beyond one interception. This unit should bounce back and look great in matchups against the Dolphins and Raiders over the next two weeks.

news.body: The Rams D/ST allowed 37 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 37 points in OT loss
news.impact: Los Angeles had a tough time slowing the Bills offense, especially on the ground as Buffalo racked up 234 rushing yards. The Rams did recover a James Cook fumble in overtime. The Rams will look to bounce back against the Cardinals in Week 6.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 20 points in Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 20 points Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' had a decent performance in Week 4, but they weren't able to log any turnovers, which hurt their final fantasy score. This is a strong unit but shouldn't be started in next week's tough matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 24 points in Sunday night's loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Rams D/ST underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense was underwhelming on Sunday night. They weren't able to log many big plays over the course of the night, and they allowed Denver's offense to score 24 points in primetime. This unit has a tough schedule coming up, which makes it hard to get excited for them from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two sacks and an interception while allowing just six points in Monday night's blowout win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense looked good on Monday night. They held the Giants' offense to just six points on the night, but that was also aided by the multiple key injuries that New York suffered over the course of the night. This unit can be started in a matchup against the Broncos next week, although that is by no means an easy game for them.

news.body: The Patriots D/ST allowed 252 passing yards, 97 rushing yards, and 19 points in a win over the Jets.
news.head: Patriots D/ST solid in Week 6
news.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied three sacks and forced the first interception of the season for Geno Smith. The Patriots' defense will take on a high-powered Bears' offense in Week 7.

news.body: The Patriots D/ST allowed 268 passing yards, 38 rushing yards, and 17 points in a win over the Raiders Sunday.
news.head: Patriots D/ST allows 17 points in Week 5 win
news.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied three sacks and one fumble recovery in the win over Las Vegas. The Patriots' defense was able to hold the Raiders to 2.1 yards per carry and will look to turn in a similar performance against the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: The Patriots D/ST allowed 253 passing yards, 91 rushing yards, and 26 points in a win over the Bills.
news.head: Patriots D/ST allows 26 points in Week 4 win
news.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied one sack, one fumble recovery, and one interception in the win Sunday. The interception was on the final drive for the Bills, helping the Patriots seal their second win of the season. The Patriots will take on the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: The Patriots' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 35 points in Sunday's blowout loss at the hands of the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Patriots D/ST dismal in blowout loss Sunday
news.impact: New England's defense was terrible on Sunday. They allowed Jacksonville to score 35 points over the course of the afternoon, and they weren't able to make any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started for the foreseeable future, especially with a tough matchup against the Bills coming up next week.

news.body: The Saints D/ST allowed 27 points on 461 total yards with three interceptions, one fumble recovery and five sacks on Sunday against the Giants.
news.head: Saints D/ST records three interceptions Sunday
news.impact: The Saints defense looked good early against Jameis Winston. They struggled late when J.J. McCarthy entered the game. They'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: The Saints D/ST recorded two sacks while also forcing two turnovers ( two fumble recoveries) in a 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
news.head: Saints D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 5
news.impact: The unit struggled to make consistent stops throughout the afternoon, allowing 364 offensive yards in the loss. The defense should remain out of lineups in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest with the New York Giants.

news.body: The Saints' D/ST logged just one sack and allowed 45 points in Monday night's blowout loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Saints D/ST dismal in blowout loss Monday
news.impact: New Orleans' defense looked bad on Monday night. They allowed Atlanta to run all over them and score a whopping 45 points over the course of the night, and they weren't able to log any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has been bad over the start of the season and should not be started at all moving forward.

news.body: The Saints D/ST allowed 35 points on 381 total yards with three sacks and a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Raiders.
news.head: Saints D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
news.impact: The Saints were unable to force any interceptions on Kirk Cousins. It did not help that the Saints offense turned the ball over four times in the final quarter. They'll face Bijan Robinson and the Falcons next week.

news.body: The Giants defense allowed 34 points on 319 total yards with a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Saints.
news.head: Giants D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
news.impact: The Giants were unable to record any sacks on the day. They'll face CJ Stroud and the Texans next week.

news.body: The Giants D/ST recorded five sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Giants D/ST records five sacks in Week 5
news.impact: The defense struggled to stop Washington on the ground, allowing 202 rushing yards and three rushing touchdowns on the day. The unit will look to offer more impactful results against an inconsistent New Orleans Saints offense in Week 6.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged three interceptions, two sacks, and a touchdown while allowing 24 points in Sunday's win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Giants D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense was stellar on Sunday. They logged three interceptions over the course of the afternoon, one of them they were able to take all the way back for a touchdown. They ended with a stellar fantasy total on the day, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect that to be a habit for them over the course of the season.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one interception and one fumble recovery while allowing seven points in Sunday's win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Giants D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense held the Titans to just seven points on Sunday, which ultimately led to the Giants escaping with a win despite scoring just 12 points themselves. This unit lost Brian Burns (knee) in the process, however, as he is likely to miss the rest of the season with what is suspected to be a torn ACL. His absence will significantly hurt their defensive front and pass rush moving forward.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 235 passing yards, 148 rushing yards, and 26 points in a loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 26 points in Week 6 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense failed to record a sack or interception in the game, but did recover two fumbles in the loss. The Jets' defense are a solid streaming option in Week 7 against Miami.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed just 12 points while racking up eight sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Jets D/ST notches eight sacks in Week 5 win
news.impact: New York's defense made it a long afternoon for Deshaun Watson and company on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. The Jets were led by rookie David Bailey, who had three sacks. The Jets will have a tougher test in Week 6 against the Patriots.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 23 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 23-12 loss to the Bears in Week 4.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 23 points in Week 4 loss
news.impact: New York's defense played reasonably well against Chicago, but they were unable to come away with the win. They will look to slow down a hot Browns team at home in Week 5.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 31 points, 269 passing yards, and 131 rushing yards in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks of Jared Goff, but failed to force a turnover in the loss. They may have an easier matchup in Week 4 with Caleb Williams (hamstring) unlikely to play for the Bears.

news.body: The Eagles defense surrendered only 19 points on 408 yards of total offense, coming up with two sacks and one interception in Sunday's 19-17 loss.
news.head: Eagles D/ST allows just 19 points to high-powered Jaguars
news.impact: The Eagles played a bend-don't-break brand of defense Sunday, and it was almost enough to get them an upset victory over the Jaguars. The unit really clamped down in the red zone and held the Jacksonville running backs to just 3.2 yards per carry on the day. The Eagles will face another stiff test against the Panthers in Week 6.

news.body: The Eagles' D/ST logged two interceptions and one sack while allowing 24 points in Sunday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Eagles D/ST logs two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense had an up-and-down game on Sunday. They logged two interceptions and didn't allow Matthew Stafford to score a single touchdown through the air, but they allowed three on the ground and allowed Los Angeles to put up 24 points en route to a win on the road. This unit should only be started in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.head: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3
news.impact: It was a poor performance by the Eagles on Monday night as they couldn't stop Case Keenum from carving them up. Keenum hadn't appeared in a regular-season game since 2023, but he tossed two touchdowns and ran for a third. The Eagles will look to regroup in a tough Week 4 matchup against the Rams.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 20 points while adding two sacks in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Eagles D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 2
news.impact: Philadelphia held Tennessee to 291 yards of total offense but they needed a last-minute TD pass from Jalen Hurts to avoid the upset. The Eagles will now head on the road to take on a Bears offense that could be without Caleb Williams (hamstring) in Week 3.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST operated on a "bend, don't break" basis in the team's 34-22 win against the Colts on Sunday. They managed only a single sack and no turnovers against the Colts, but it was enough.
news.head: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST contains Indy offense in win
news.impact: The Steelers didn't get much in terms of counting stats, but they kept the Colts out of the end zone and forced them to take a multitude of field goals. In every other game so far, they've generated at least two turnovers, helping boost their overall fantasy scoring, but that wasn't the case for them today. They're not an incredible option at defense, but they're a usable streaming option.

news.body: The Steelers' D/ST allowed 27 points on 372 yards of total offense, recording five sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points for the second straight week
news.impact: The Steelers' defense made plenty of big plays in Thursday's loss. The unit also gave up a few too many big plays. The Steelers have allowed division rivals to put up exactly 27 points in back-to-back weeks. There's no doubting the Pittsburgh pass rush, but as a whole, the defense has been showing some holes. The Colts are next up.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 27 points, 282 passing yards, and 83 rushing yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Steelers' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery in the win Sunday. The fumble recovery came on the final drive for the Bengals to help seal the win for the Steelers. The defense will now prepare for the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 14 points, 208 passing yards, and 136 rushing yards in the 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Steelers' defense did tally an interception, a fumble recovery, and three sacks in the losing effort Sunday. The Steelers' defense will be at home against a strong Bengals' offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST managed two sacks in the team's 17-14 loss to Denver.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST stifles Denver despite loss
news.impact: They didn't put much else up on the box score, but they largely played a good game, with both of the Broncos' touchdown drives coming in the second quarter, and largely being shut down besides that. They'll have better fantasy performances in the coming weeks.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 25 points on 269 total yards with one interception, two fumble recoveries and three sacks on Sunday against the 49ers.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST impresses despite final score Sunday
news.impact: While San Francisco scored 32 points, 7 points came off a fumble by George Holani recovered in the end zone for a touchdown. San Francisco also scored two other touchdowns in the first half off short field from two other turnovers in the first half. They'll face Bo Nix in Denver on Thursday.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 23 points on 301 total yards with two interceptions, two fumble recoveries and four sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks defense was at its best early in the first half. They struggled a bit more late as the Chargers nearly overcame a 21 point deficit. The Seahawks will face Brock Purdy and the 49ers next week.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST quiet in Week 3
news.impact: The unit fell victim to a Seattle offense that turned the ball over three times in the loss. The defense will look to get back to its aggressive scheme in a Week 4 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST allowed 29 points on 251 total yards with two interceptions, two fumble recoveries and five sacks on Sunday against the Seahawks.
news.head: 49ers D/ST forces four turnovers Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco forced three turnovers in the first half, including a fumble recovery for a touchdown at the end of the first half. They'll take on Jayden Daniels and the Commanders next week.

news.body: The 49ers' D/ST allowed 14 points and 296 total yards while recovering one fumble in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. San Francisco did not record a sack or interception.
news.head: 49ers D/ST holds Broncos to 14 points Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco didn't make many plays from a fantasy standpoint, but the defense did its job by keeping Denver out of the end zone until the fourth quarter. A special teams fumble recovery also helped set up San Francisco's first touchdown. The lack of sacks is worth monitoring, but the 49ers remain a viable fantasy defense heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST allowed 30 points on 365 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
news.head: 49ers D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco allowed just six points in the first half before allowing 24 points in the second half. They'll face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

news.body: The 49ers' defense allowed just 13 points on 284 yards of offense while recording four sacks in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: 49ers D/ST records four sacks, stifles Dolphins offense
news.impact: For the second straight week, the 49ers' defense dominated. The unit has surrendered just 20 points in two games, holding both the Rams and Dolphins under 300 yards of total offense. The 49ers will remain a popular play in Week 3 against the Cardinals.

news.body: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST racked up two interceptions and a fumble recovery in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
news.head: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST contain Cowboys in win
news.impact: The Bucs' defense was pliable on the Cowboys' first drive of the game, but stiffened significantly after that. They did give up a touchdown in the fourth quarter, but managed to make a crucial interception when Dallas was attempting to force overtime. It was a much better showing than we previously had seen from Tampa's defense, but don't call it a comeback just yet.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 17 points while recording an interception and recovering a fumble in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Tampa Bay's defense was solid in the loss, allowing just 283 total yards of offense. They recovered a Kaleb Johnson fumble while Jacob Parrish intercepted Jordan Love. Tampa Bay's defense will have a tough matchup in Week 5 against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on 230 total yards with an interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Vikings.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST records interception Sunday
news.impact: The Bucs defense did everything they could to keep the team in the game. They'll face Jordan Love and the Packers next week.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on 267 total yards with two sacks.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST allows 23 points Sunday
news.impact: It was a prime matchup for Tampa Bay against Deshaun Watson and the Browns offense and they failed to come through. They draw the Vikings next week.

news.body: Andre Szmyt hit both of his field-goal tries while missing his lone extra point in a 17-12 loss to the Jets in Week 5.
news.head: Andre Szmyt hits two FGs in Week 5
news.impact: Szmyt hit field goals from 25 and 41 yards out. His lone extra-point try went off the right goalpost on a rainy day at MetLife Stadium. Szmyt has now connected on all 10 of his field goals this season. He will head back home to Cleveland to face off against the Ravens in Week 6.

news.body: Andre Szmyt made both of his field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Browns.
news.head: Andre Szmyt puts nine points on the board in Thursday's win
news.impact: The Browns won three straight games, and suddenly Szmyt looks like a very useful fantasy option. The second-year pro hit a career-long 56-yard FG with 10 seconds left to win Thursday's contest, and he's been perfect on eight three-point attempts and seven PATs so far this season.

news.body: Andre Szmyt went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 21-18 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Andre Szmyt perfect in win Sunday
news.impact: The Browns were able to pick up a narrow win over the Panthers on Sunday, which Szmyt was able to help with by accounting for a third of the team's total points in this matchup. He doesn't project to be a good fantasy option at the position for the remainder of the season, however.

news.body: Andre Szmyt connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Andre Szmyt connects on five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Szmyt made field goals from 50 yards out plus two more from 34 yards out. He is less reliable week-to-week on the Browns offense.

news.body: Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 2-of-3 extra point attempts in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: Andy Borregales makes two field goals in Week 6
news.impact: Borregales missed his first extra point of the season, but connected on field goals from 27 and 32 yards out to help pace the Patriots to their fourth win of the year. Borregales and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

news.body: Andy Borregales made six extra points and his lone field goal in the Patriots win over the Raiders Sunday.
news.head: Andy Borregales perfect in Week 5 win
news.impact: Borregales made a 28-yared field goal in the second half for his lone field goal on the day. Borregales will look to build on this performance against the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Andy Borregales made all three of his extra point attempts in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Andy Borregales perfect in Week 4 win
news.impact: Borregales was not called upon to attempt any field goals in the win Sunday. The second-year kicker is 5-for-7 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra point attempts so far this season.

news.body: Andy Borregales went 2-for-3 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Andy Borregales misses field goal in loss Sunday
news.impact: Borregales didn't have a great game on Sunday, missing one of his three field-goal attempts in the team's blowout loss at the hands of the Jaguars. If he continues to play bad, his job could be in jeopardy at some point in the season.

news.body: The Rams signed kicker Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad.
news.head: Blake Grupe signed by Rams
news.impact: Grupe will get an opportunity with the Rams with Harrison Mevis released.

news.body: The Jets claimed Blake Grupe off waivers.
news.head: Blake Grupe claimed off waivers by Jets
news.impact: Grupe was previously released by the Colts. He'll compete to be the starting kicker for the Jets.

news.body: The Colts released K Blake Grupe.
news.head: Blake Grupe released by Colts
news.impact: Spencer Shrader will kick for the Colts this year. Grupe will seek another opportunity.

news.body: The Colts have signed kicker Blake Grupe to a one-year deal.
news.head: Blake Grupe signs one-year deal with Colts
news.impact: Grupe can earn up to $1.4 million on his one-year pact. Grupe went 11-for-11 on his field goals after the Colts signed him in December. His fantasy value this season will depend on Spencer Shrader, who is currently recovering from knee surgery.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey hit his only PAT and field goal attempts in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey kick for four points in loss
news.impact: Aubrey was hindered by a Dallas offense that sputtered badly after their first drive, failing to do much more in the first half before a field goal. After that, the team was in catch-up mode, and Aubrey didn't see the field again. Better days will come for the star kicker.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made 2-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey hit a 39 and 50-yard field goal early. He later had a 62-yarder blocked and missed a 65-yard field goal.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made three of his four field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes three FGs in Week 3
news.impact: Aubrey made field goals from 28, 38, and 23 yards out in the close loss to Baltimore. The veteran kicker has now hit six of his seven field-goal tries and added eight extra points this year. He will take on the Texans in Week 4.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey connected on all three field goal attempts and all four of his extra point attempts in a win over the Commanders.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Aubrey connected on field goals from 25, 44, and 60 yards out to help pace the Cowboys to their first win over the season. Aubrey remains one of the best kickers in the league and is a strong start against Baltimore in Week 3.

news.body: Cairo Santos converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as one of two field goal attempts to finish with seven points in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
news.head: Cairo Santos misses field goal in Week 6
news.impact: Santos continues to take advantage of his opportunities behind a productive Chicago offense, recording seven or more points in four of six contests. The kicker will look for another reliable performance in Week 7 against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Cairo Santos missed his only field goal attempt while making his lone extra point attempt in the Bears’ 31-7 loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 5.
news.head: Cairo Santos misses field goal in Week 5
news.impact: Santos has taken advantage of a strong Chicago offense early on, recording nine points or more in three of five games. The kicker will look for another impactful performance in Week 6 against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Cairo Santos made all three of his field goals and added two extra points in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Cairo Santos makes three FGs in Week 4
news.impact: Santos made field goals from 30, 30, and 21 yards out in the win. The veteran kicker has made seven of his eight field-goal attempts and all 13 of his extra points thus far. He will take on the Packers in Week 5.

news.body: Cairo Santos made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3's Monday night game.
news.head: Cairo Santos makes two FGs in Week 3
news.impact: Santos hit field goals from 29 and 48 yards out in the decisive victory over Philadelphia. The veteran kicker has made four of his five field-goal attempts and added 11 extra points through three games this year. He will take on the Jets in Week 4.

news.body: Cam Little connected on his lone field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-31 loss to Houston.
news.head: Cam Little perfect in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Little connected on a 60-yard field goal for his lone make of the day. Little has missed just one kick this season and continues to show that he has one of the strongest legs in the game. Little and the Jaguars will head to their bye in Week 7.

news.body: Cam Little made both of his field-goal attempts and 1-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Cam Little nails long game-winner in Week 5
news.impact: After missing a PAT that could have put the Jaguars up by three late in the fourth quarter, Little got a chance to make up for it with just one tick of the clock remaining during a wild finish Sunday. Little made good on the opportunity, drilling a 57-yard attempt as time expired to give the Jaguars a victory. That is Little's longest make of the season through five weeks, and he's now 9-of-11 overall on field goals for the campaign. He's one of the top kickers in the league.

news.body: Cam Little went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Cam Little scores ten points in win Sunday
news.impact: Little made all four of his kicks on Sunday, including one from 55 yards out, which left him with a nice fantasy total in this win over the Bengals. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a good option at the kicker position moving forward.

news.body: Cam Little made all five of his extra-point attempts and missed his lone field-goal attempt from 70 yards out in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Cam Little totals five points in win Sunday
news.impact: Little ended up with just five points on Sunday, which is a little disappointing considering how easily scoring came to the Jaguars against New England. He also barely missed one kick from what would have been an NFL record 70-yards out, which further hurt his fantasy total in this matchup. He should bounce back in the near future.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made both of his field-goal attempts in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Cameron Dicker Scores Chargers' Only Points in Week 6
news.impact: Dicker connected from 23 and 30 yards for all six of Los Angeles' points. He did his job when called upon, but the Chargers' inability to consistently reach scoring range limits his fantasy ceiling.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made his only field-goal attempt and both of his PATs in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Cameron Dicker puts five points on the board Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers' anemic offense just hasn't given Dicker enough chances to be a real fantasy asset among kickers through the first five weeks. The fifth-year pro is 7-of-9 on field-goal attempts through five games with a long of 42 yards. He's made all nine of his PATs to this point.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Cameron Dicker makes three field goals Sunday
news.impact: Dicker connected on field goals from 40, 39 and 36 yards out. Despite the Chargers struggles, he remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cameron Dicker converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts while also making his lone extra point attempt to finish with 10 points in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Dicker made the most of increased opportunities for head coach Jim Harbaugh, finishing with more than two points for the first time in three contests. The kicker has fallen victim to kicking behind an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.body: Chris Boswell hit all four of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Boswell puts up 10 kicking points in win
news.impact: Boswell was making all of his chances count in this game, perfect for the fantasy managers who started him. He's been a bit up and down this year due to some misses, but that's to be expected. And if it's any consolation, two of his three misses were on field goal tries beyond 50 yards.

news.body: Chris Boswell made 1-of-2 field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Chris Boswell accounts for four points in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Boswell made a field goal from 31 yards and missed another from 48 yards Thursday night. With the Steelers trying a pair of two-point conversions during a fourth-quarter comeback, the veteran kicker attempted only one PAT on the night. Through four games, Boswell is 7-of-10 on FG attempts and has made all six of his PATs. He's a middle-of-the-road fantasy option at the moment.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Chris Boswell prefect in Week 3 win
news.impact: Boswell had a much needed bounce back performance after missing kicks in each of his first two games. The veteran made field goals from 33, 36, and 44 yards out to help pace the Steelers to a win. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on 1-of-2 field goals in the Steelers 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Chris Boswell misses a FG attempt in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Boswell connected on a 56-yard field goal and missed from 57-yards out in the first quarter. There were reports prior to the game that Boswell was struggling with kicks in pregame warmups, but both his miss and connection were from 55+ yards. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Bengals at home in Week 3.

news.body: Dominic Zvada connected on both his field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Dominic Zvada makes all three kicks Sunday
news.impact: Zvada made field goals from 34 and 41 yards out on the afternoon.

news.body: Dominic Zvada converted all three of his extra point attempts while missing three of his five field goal attempts to finish with nine points in the Giants’ 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Dominic Zvada misses three field goals in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Zvada has made the most of increased opportunities of late despite the three misses Sunday, recording nine or more points in each of his last three contests. The kicker will look to offer more consistency in a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Dominic Zvada went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Dominic Zvada scores ten points Sunday
news.impact: Zvada looked good on Sunday, making all four of his kicks and finishing with ten points in a win over the Cardinals. He has looked good recently and can safely be started in what should be a high-scoring affair against the Commanders next week.

news.body: Dominic Zvada made all four of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Dominic Zvada totals 12 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Zvada was one of the lone bright spots for New York on Sunday, making all four of his kicks and accounting for all of New York's points en route to a narrow win over the Titans. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward, however.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro went 1-of-2 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro hits go-ahead field goal Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro missed a field goal from 52 yards out to begin the second half. He made the one that went on to win the game for San Francisco just after the two-minute warning.

news.body: Eddy Piñeiro made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. His field goal conversion came from 24 yards out.
news.head: Eddy Piñeiro makes four kicks in win Sunday
news.impact: Piñeiro finished with six points despite missing out on one field-goal opportunity. San Francisco continues to give him scoring chances behind one of the league's better offenses, which keeps him on the fantasy radar heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal and 3-of-5 extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro misses two extra points Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. It was a rare off day for him kicking extra points.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal but made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes five PATs in Sunday's win
news.impact: The 49ers found the end zone with each of their first five drives Sunday afternoon, and did not give Pineiro any field-goal chances. That's obviously not going to be the case each week. The veteran should be a solid fantasy option for a squad that looks really strong so far.

news.body: Harrison Butker made three of four field-goal attempts and one of two extra-point attempts in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Harrison Butker Connects on Three Field Goals in Week 6
news.impact: Butker connected from 44, 50 and 30 yards, with the 50-yarder giving fantasy managers a boost. He left points on the field with a missed field goal and extra point, but Kansas City's offense continues to give him enough opportunities to remain a weekly starting option.

news.body: Harrison Butker made his lone field-goal attempt and added three extra points in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Harrison Butker makes one FG in Week 4
news.impact: Butker hit a 28-yard field goal in the close win over Las Vegas. The veteran kicker has made seven of his nine field-goal attempts and added 13 extra points on the year. He will be on bye in Week 5 before a Week 6 matchup vs. the Chargers.

news.body: Harrison Butker converted all three of his extra point attempts while missing 1-of-2 field goal attempts to finish with six points in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Harrison Butker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Butker continues a solid start to the season, recording six or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more stable options in all formats behind a revamped Kansas City offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-5 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Harrison Butker scores 15 points in OT win Sunday
news.impact: Butker missed one field goal on Sunday night, but outside of that, he was perfect. He made all seven of his other kicks, including a walk-off kick which secured the win for Kansas City in overtime. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Jason Myers hit two of three field goal attempts in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He did not attempt a PAT.
news.head: Jason Myers has big miss in loss to Denver
news.impact: Meyers had a miss in the third quarter that ended up being crucial in the game, as the game went to overtime tied 14-14. Had Meyers connected, it's entirely possible the Seahawks pull off the low-scoring win. However, history is history, and the only thing he can do is move on.

news.body: Jason Myers connected on 5-of-5 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers has big day Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks struggled to put the ball in the end zone on Sunday, which Myers took advantage of. He is now 10-of-10 on field goal attempts on the season.

news.body: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers makes lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: Myers made his lone field goal from 35 yards out. He missed a 53-yard field goal earlier in the drive, but a leverage penalty on the Chargers gave the Seahawks an automatic first down.

news.body: Jason Myers converted his only field goal attempt as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Jason Myers racks up seven points in Week 3
news.impact: Myers continues a strong start to the season, recording seven points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options in related formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on four field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 45, 35, 26 and 53 yards out all in the first half. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 3-of-3 field goals and extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on all six kicks Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 51, 39 and 54 yards. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on his lone field goal attempts and two extra point attempts in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn perfect in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Fairbairn made his lone field goal attempt for 24-yard outs in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old has missed just one kick so far in the first three games. Houston will take on Dallas in Week 4.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-3 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn connected on field goals from 37 and 45 yards out. He missed from 58 yards out in the third quarter.

news.body: Matt Gay made 1-of-2 field goals and both of his extra points in the Raiders loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Matt Gay accounts for five points in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Gay banged a 49-yard field goal attempt off the upright late in the second quarter, but was able to connect from 46-yards out in the third quarter. Gay and the Raiders will take on the Bills in Week 6.

news.body: Matt Gay made all four of his field-goal attempts and added one extra point in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Matt Gay makes four FGs in Week 4
news.impact: Gay hit field goals from 32, 48, 44, and 48 yards out in the close loss. The veteran has now made all 10 of his field goals in 2026. He will take on the Patriots in Week 5.

news.body: Matt Gay made 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Matt Gay connects on five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Gay connected on field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out. He is 7-for-7 on field goal attempts through the first three games.

news.body: Matt Gay went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Matt Gay perfect in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran kicker played well on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Chargers. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however, with a tough schedule coming up for Las Vegas.

news.body: Spencer Shrader hit both of his field goal attempts and both PATs in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Spencer Shrader has 8 kicking points in loss
news.impact: Shrader continued his impressive streak of scoring, albeit a little less than the output he's been producing recently. Keep him in lineups as a top-tier kicking option.

news.body: Spencer Shrader hit his only PAT and all five of his field goal attempts in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Spencer Shrader has huge day in loss
news.impact: Shrader had himself a day in this one, and while some fantasy managers in kicking leagues will be happy, most managers with Colts will be upset, and Shrader's usage meant that the offense stalled often in scoring position, only setting up field goals. Still, 16 kicking points is great, and he did his part to put points on the board for the team, but the offense will have to be better if they want to stay in the playoff race.

news.body: Spencer Shrader made 3-of-3 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders.
news.head: Spencer Shrader makes three field goals in Week 4 win
news.impact: Shrader made field goals from 44, 48, and 52 yards out to help pace the Colts to the win in London. The 27-year-old has not missed a field goal attempt this season and will look to continue his strong season against the Steelers in Week 5.

news.body: Spencer Shrader connected on all four of his field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt in a 19-17 win over the Texans.
news.head: Spencer Shrader perfect in Week 3
news.impact: Shrader reportedly sustained a groin injury in warmups Sunday, but it did not impact his performance against Houston. Shrader made field goals from 37, 39, 53, and 58 yards to help pace the Colts to their first win of the season. Shrader and the Colts will take on the Commanders in Week 3.

news.body: Trey Smack converted one of his three field goal attempts as well as two of his three extra point attempts to finish with five points in the Packers’ 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Trey Smack struggles in Week 5
news.impact: Smack has struggled to convert consistently of late, missing kicks in two of the last three games. The kicker will look to get back on track in a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: Trey Smack made his lone field-goal attempt and added two extra points in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Trey Smack hits 58-yard FG in Week 4
news.impact: Smack drilled a 58-yard field goal at the end of the first half. The rookie kicker has made six of his seven field-goal attempts and seven extra points on the year. He will take on the Bears in Week 5.

news.body: Trey Smack hit both of his PATs in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Trey Smack quiet in loss to Falcons
news.impact: Smack hit both of his chances, but the Packers either couldn't get into field goal range, or decided to go for it on fourth down when they did. Better days will come for the kicker, and the Green Bay offense can still put up points on any given week. Their run game is stifling them at the moment, so if they figure that out, the points will come.

news.body: Trey Smack converted each of his two field goal attempts as well as both of his extra point attempts to finish with eight points in the Packers’ 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
news.head: Trey Smack picks up eight points in Week 2
news.impact: Smack continues a strong start to the season, racking up eight or more points in each of the first two games. The kicker will look for more success in a favorable Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and hit two of his three extra points in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Tyler Bass wins it in OT for Bills in Week 5
news.impact: Bass hit field goals from 49, 23, and 45 yards out in the win. His 45-yard attempt won the game for the Bills with two minutes left in overtime. Bass has now hit all 10 of his field-goal attempts this season. He will take on the Raiders in Week 6.

news.body: Tyler Bass connected on both of his field goal attempts and both extra point attempts in the loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 4
news.impact: Bass connected on field goal attempts of 27 and 38 yard field goals in the loss to New England. Bass is 6-for-6 on field goal attempts and has missed on extra point so far this season. Bass and the Bills will head on the road to take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Tyler Bass converted his only field goal attempt as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 3
news.impact: Bass has offered modest output to begin the season, recording five or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker benefits from playing behind one of the more high-powered offenses on a regular basis, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Tyler Bass went 5-for-6 on his extra-point attempts in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tyler Bass scores five points Thursday
news.impact: Bass ended Thursday night's game with a total of five points, but he missed one of his extra point attempts in this game, which was less than ideal. He should remain a solid fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward.

news.body: Tyler Loop made all three of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Sunday night's 30-23 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Tyler Loop hits three field goals in Sunday's win
news.impact: Loop is now 9-of-11 on field goals with a long of 64 yards through five games. He's also made 15-of-15 PATs. The second-year pro impressed as a rookie, and he's further cemented himself as a reliable kicker so far this season.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Ravens win over the Titans.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes 64-yard field goal in Week 4 win
news.impact: Loop connected on a 64-yard field goal attempt to close out the first half. He would later miss a 40-yard attempt late in the fourth quarter. Loop is 6-for-8 so far on field goal attempts this season.

news.body: Tyler Loop made both of his field goals and added four extra points in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Tyler Loop nails 56-yard game-winning FG in Week 3
news.impact: Loop provided the heroics as he hit a 56-yard field goal with a second left in the game to break a 31-31 tie. The veteran kicker has made five of his six field goals and added 11 extra points through three games this season. He will be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in the Ravens loss to the Saints.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes one field goal in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Loop had a 49-yard field goal blocked in the first half, but made a 49-yard field goal in the second half. The Ravens take on the Cowboys in Week 3, which should provide Loop with plenty of chances in what should be a high scoring matchup.

news.body: Will Reichard converted both of his extra point attempts as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 11 points in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
news.head: Will Reichard racks up 11 points in Week 5 win
news.impact: Reichard continues a dynamic start to the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, racking up seven or more points in each of the first five games. The kicker remains one of the more dynamic options in associated formats as Minnesota enters a Week 6 bye.

news.body: Will Reichard made all five of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Will Reichard scores 15 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Reichard had a great game on Sunday, being responsible for all 15 of Minnesota's points in their close win over the Dolphins. He should continue to be a viable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Will Reichard connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard makes five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Reichard made field goals from 54, 56 and 43 yards out. He hit two huge field goals late in the fourth quarter to help Minnesota hold off the Bucs.

news.body: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts to finish with nine points in a Week 2 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Will Reichard perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Reichard continues a strong start to the season, recording seven or more points in each of the first two games. The kicker will look to provide another solid performance against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 33-of-49 passes for 253 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers throws for 253 yards Sunday
news.impact: Rodgers threw an interception early, but he was able to bounce back and lead the Steelers to an overtime win. He was able to connect 11 times with both DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. He'll be in the streaming conversation next week against the Saints.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 31 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns, also running once for six yards in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers tosses three touchdowns in win
news.impact: Rodgers had himself a day against the struggling Colts defense, taking only a single sack and not throwing an interception. He has been on fire in the last few weeks, with three touchdowns in each of his last three games. He's a streamable option if the matchup is right, and that could be as soon as next week against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers turns in another big passing performance
news.impact: For the second straight week, Rodgers tossed three touchdowns while coming up just short of 300 yards. This time, however, it was not enough for a win. Rodgers threw multiple interceptions for the first time this season on Thursday night, and that helped the Browns build a 14-point lead. Rodgers did bring the Steelers back, leading two TD drives in the fourth quarter, but the Steelers' defense couldn't stop the Browns' game-winning drive. Rodgers has gotten into a groove with his receivers the last two games, and an attractive matchup with the Colts awaits in Week 5.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 19-of-34 passes for 292 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 win
news.impact: Rodgers turned in his best performance of the season so far, averaging 8.6 yards per pass attempt in the win. He was able to find Roman Wilson, DK Metcalf, and Ben Skowronek for his three touchdown passes. Rodgers and the Steelers will look to build on this strong performance against the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: There’s reportedly “optimism” Baker Mayfield will return in Week 7 against the Panthers.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) could return in Week 7
news.impact: Mayfield didn’t practice this week, but he resumed throwing on Monday. His status will need to be monitored in practice next week.

news.body: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said it’s “too early to tell” if Baker Mayfield will be able to play in Week 7 against the Panthers.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) uncertain for Week 7
news.impact: Mayfield remains week-to-week as he has yet to resume throwing. Jalon Daniels will continue to start this week.

news.body: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Mayfield has yet to resume throwing. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Baker Mayfield (thumb) remained sidelined for another practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) remains sidelined at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran quarterback is still managing a thumb injury and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It seems like he will miss at least another game or two while he recovers, which will likely leave rookie Jalon Daniels as the team's starter once again in Week 6.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-29 passes for 189 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy led two scoring drives on short field off two turnovers early in the game. He connected several times with Mike Evans late including a two-point conversion. He was sacked three times, the first time he had been taken to the ground all season. He draws a strong matchup next week against the Commanders.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19 of 30 passing attempts for 218 yards and two touchdowns, adding 29 yards on the ground in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Brock Purdy throws two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Purdy didn't put up a big yardage total, but he took care of the football and threw both of his touchdowns in the second half. He has San Francisco at 4-0 and continues to give fantasy managers a solid floor as a low-end QB1 in one of the NFL's better offenses. Purdy will face the Seattle Seahawks in Week 5.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 15-of-27 passes for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses four touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy also had a rushing score late that was called back on a penalty by George Kittle. His first passing touchdown was a completion to Mike Evans, who lateraled the ball to Deebo Samuel for the long score. He draws a tougher matchup against the Broncos next week.

news.body: Brock Purdy connected on 20-of-22 passes for 287 yards and two touchdowns, adding 30 yards and a touchdown on three carries in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Brock Purdy turns in tremendous effort against Dolphins
news.impact: Purdy is off to an outstanding start this season, and he could hardly have been more prolific in Sunday's rout of the Dolphins. The fifth-year QB has completed a ridiculous 80.4% of his passes so far, averaging 246 yards with a 5-1 TD/INT ratio through two games. Purdy has also rushed for 59 yards on eight carries, including a two-yard scoring scramble on Sunday. He'll be a QB to start against the Cardinals in Week 3.

news.body: Carolina Panthers quarterback Bryce Young completed 20 of 39 passes for 281 yards and two touchdowns against the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 6.
news.head: Bryce Young tosses pair of scores in Week 6 win
news.impact: Young delivered against a talented Philly defense with his fourth multi-touchdown game in five weeks. He has two scores and no turnovers in each of the last two games, emerging from the Week 5 bye with the same flair. Young has at least 280 passing yards in every game, giving him an impressive floor at quarterback.

news.body: Bryce Young (knee) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Bryce Young (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was previously managing a knee issue, but he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday, so it seems to be a non-issue for him as the team comes off of their bye week. He should play in Week 6 and will look to continue to build on his momentum against a tough Eagles' defense.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 29 of 41 passes for 329 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Bryce Young picks apart Detroit pass defense in Week 4
news.impact: Young cleared 300 yards passing for the second time this season on Sunday night and has thrown for a minimum of 287 through four weeks. The 25-year-old QB certainly seems to have stepped up to a new level. Through Sunday, he leads the league in passing yards, with a 62.3% completion rate and 9-2 TD/INT ratio. The Panthers are off in Week 5, but Young should be viewed among the QB1 ranks most weeks after that.

news.body: Bryce Young is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Bryce Young (knee) off injury report Sunday
