news.impact: Young received a precautionary MRI at the start of the week. He has been able to practice in full and is officially good to go for Sunday.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 pass attempts for 305 yards and one touchdown while also rushing four times for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Caleb Williams efficient in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Williams was impactful in his return to the lineup for head coach Ben Johnson, surpassing 300 passing yards for the first time in his three contests while battling a hamstring injury. The dual-threat signal-caller remains a dynamic lineup option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is the starter for the Bears on Sunday against the Falcons. After a few weeks' absence, the franchise QB is back.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) starting for the Bears Sunday
news.impact: Williams was initially questionable to play, but the Bears are now planning on getting him back in the lineup after a week of practice where he took starter reps. It will be interesting to see Caleb in a more "regular" game and how it affects the pass catchers, who have only played with Caleb in one normal game, and even that "normal" game saw copious amounts of production from the running backs.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Williams has been out for several games while tending to a hamstring injury, but he is officially questionable and will have a chance to make his return in Week 6 after being a full participant at practice all week. It looks more likely than not that he will play, which would be good news for Rome Odunze, Luther Burden III, and all of Chicago's fantasy options in a matchup against the Falcons.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) practices in full again Thursday
news.impact: Williams has now logged two-straight full practices to start the week, which all but confirms that he will be back in the lineup and starting for Chicago this week. His anticipated return will be good news for the fantasy value of Chicago's entire offense moving forward.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 24-of-34 pass attempts for 312 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Jaguars. He rushed for five yards on his lone rushing attempt.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
news.impact: Stroud found 10 different pass catchers as he spread the ball around effectively and kept the Jaguars' defense guessing. Stroud has eclipsed 300 yards passing in three games this season and set a new season high with three touchdown passes. Houston will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 26-of-34 passes for 261 yards and one touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: C.J. Stroud totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud also added a rushing score at the goal line. He was able to take care of the ball in a game where the Texans defense dominated. He'll be a QB2 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-31 passes for 347 yards with two touchdowns in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
news.head: C.J. Stroud throws for 347 yards Sunday
news.impact: Stroud was at his best on Sunday with the return of Nico Collins. He gave the team the lead in the final minutes before the defense wound up blowing it to move to 0-4 on the season. He'll be a QB2 play against the Titans next week.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 16-of-27 passes for 127 yards and a touchdown in a 19-17 loss to the Colts. He added 10 rushing yards on two attempts.
news.head: C.J. Stroud struggles in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Stroud and the Houston offense continued to struggle without Nico Collins in the lineup. For the second straight season, Stroud and the Texans have struggled early in the season, starting the year 0-3. The team will look to bounce back in Week 4 against Dallas.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards and a touchdown with two picks in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws for 316 yards in loss
news.impact: It was not Dak's best showing, struggling against a secondary that had been picked on up to this point in the season. He will look to right the ship against the Packers on Sunday Night Football a little over a week from now.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 32-of-45 passes for 335 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws for 335 yards Sunday
news.impact: Prescott exploded in the second half, targeting CeeDee Lamb early and often with the two connecting on 17 catches. Prescott should remain a QB1 play on Thursday against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 25 of his 40 passes for 276 yards and one touchdown while adding 19 yards on four rushes in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3. He added a two-point conversion pass to CeeDee Lamb in the game.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Prescott turned in a solid, if unspectacular, game in the close loss to a tough Ravens team. His lone touchdown pass went to Jake Ferguson on a 19-yard pass in the third quarter. Prescott has thrown for 730 yards, seven touchdowns, and one interception through three games this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 4 against the Texans.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 26-of-31 passes for 279 yards and four touchdowns in the win over the Commanders. He added 26 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Dak Prescott tosses four touchdowns in Week 2 win
news.impact: Prescott found CeeDee Lamb for two of his four touchdowns and Jake Ferguson for the other two in a key win over a divisional rival. Prescott and the Cowboys will look to build on this strong performance as they take on the Ravens in Week 3.

news.body: Daniel Jones completed 22-of-42 passes for 269 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. He also ran three times for 30 yards.
news.head: Daniel Jones struggles immensely in loss
news.impact: On the one hand, it was good to see Jones put up some rushing numbers. On the other hand, mistakes once again hindered his performance, with two picks and six sacks sullying his day. It was his best fantasy performance of the season, though that's not saying much. He's been a disaster this year and a contributing factor to the Colts' 2-4 start.

news.body: Daniel Jones completed 24 of 44 passes for 267 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also ran three times for four yards.
news.head: Daniel Jones throws for 267 yards in loss
news.impact: Jones has not had a great start to this season; whether or not that's due to his continued recovery from his Achilles injury is uncertain. The Colts couldn't sustain drives for most of the game, relying mainly on field goals, which is not a great sign of offensive success. He simply hasn't been the same player he was in 2025, and that's hurting the team.

news.body: Daniel Jones completed 19-of-34 pass attempts for 143 yards and one interception in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders. He rushed for two yards and one touchdown on four attempts, and accounted for a fumble lost.
news.head: Daniel Jones struggles in Week 4 win
news.impact: Jones committed both turnovers in the first half, but was able to turn things around and help pace the Colts to a win in London. Jones and the Colts will head to Pittsburgh for a matchup with the Steelers in Week 5.

news.body: Daniel Jones completed 24-of-36 passes for 235 yards, one touchdown, one interception, and two fumbles lost in a 19-17 win over the Texans. He rushed for five yards on three carries.
news.head: Daniel Jones struggles with turnovers, picks up the win in Week 3
news.impact: Jones struggled with turnovers, but was able to do enough to pace the Colts to their first win of the season. The 235 passing yards mark a new season high for the 29-year-old. Jones and the Colts will take on the Commanders in Week 4.

news.body: Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson completed 16 of his 26 passes for 164 scoreless yards in a 13-10 win over the Baltimore Ravens in Week 6. He added eight carries and 29 yards on the ground.
news.head: Deshaun Watson quiet in Week 6 win
news.impact: Watson has led the Browns to an AFC North-leading 4-2 start, including a 3-0 record at home. Week 6 was his first without a touchdown and his third game in the last four weeks with fewer than 175 passing yards. The Browns' offense has not been high-octane, and Watson has provided the fantasy output of a QB2.

news.body: Deshaun Watson completed 15 of his 33 passes for 155 yards and one touchdown while adding six rushes for 40 yards in a 17-12 loss to the Jets in Week 5.
news.head: Deshaun Watson struggles in Week 5
news.impact: Watson fumbled four times, losing one, while taking eight sacks. It was a rainy day at MetLife Stadium, which explains some of Watson's troubles, but he still needed to play better. His lone touchdown pass was a 29-yard strike to Denzel Boston in the fourth quarter. The owner of seven touchdown passes and two interceptions through five games, Watson will look to bounce back at home against the Ravens in Week 6.

news.body: Deshaun Watson completed 24 of 33 passes for 268 yards, with one touchdown and one interception, and added 22 yards on seven carries in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Deshaun Watson tosses one touchdown in Thursday's win
news.impact: Watson continues to surprise pretty much everyone with his mostly effective play during the Browns' current three-game winning streak. He did throw one pick and coughed up a fumble, but Watson also led a game-winning drive in the final two minutes after the Steelers came back from 11 down in the fourth quarter. Watson had completed 69.6% of his passes on the season, averaging better than 210 yards per game with a 6-2 TD/INT ratio. He has also rushed for 127 yards on 31 carries.

news.body: Deshaun Watson completed 16-of-30 passing attempts for 144 yards and two touchdowns while adding 45 yards on the ground in Sunday's 21-18 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Deshaun Watson scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Watson had a decent performance on Sunday, finishing with close to 200 total yards and two touchdowns in a win over the Panthers. He has played pretty well over the last two weeks, but now it remains to be seen if he will have the longevity or consistency to maintain fantasy success for the remainder of the season.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 18-of-32 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a 26-19 win over the Jets. Maye added 24 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
news.impact: Maye found DeMario Douglas, Hunter Henry, and Romeo Doubs for his three touchdown passes. Maye turned another spotless performance, logging two straight games without a turnover after throwing seven interceptions in the first four games. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 26-of-34 passes for 374 yards and four touchdowns. Maye added 29 rushing yards and one touchdown on four carries.
news.head: Drake Maye accounts for five touchdowns in Week 5 win
news.impact: Maye turned in his best performance of the season in an excellent performance against Las Vegas. Maye connected with DeMario Douglas twice, Hunter Henry, and Kyle Williams to account for his four passing touchdowns. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 22-of-37 passes for 269 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Bills. He added 54 rushing yards on eight carries, while losing one fumble.
news.head: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 4 win
news.impact: Maye led the Patriots to a comeback win on the road against the Bills, despite struggling again with some turnovers. The former first-round pick was able to find Efton Chism on a 23-yard pass to give the team the lead with under two minutes remaining. He will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: Drake Maye (shoulder) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Maye was dealing with a minor shoulder injury throughout the week, but it's not a big deal currently and he will carry no injury designation heading into the weekend. He isn't startable in most fantasy leagues at this point in the season, but this would be a good week for him to bounce back from his rough start against a struggling Buffalo defense.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 29-of-47 passing attempts for 292 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: The Cardinals suffered a blowout loss at the hands of the Lions on Sunday, but Brissett was able to have a good game from a fantasy perspective. He threw for nearly 300 yards and three touchdowns over the course of the game and limited mistakes with just one turnover in this matchup. He is a worthwhile streaming options in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 21-of-35 passing attempts for 166 yards, two touchdowns, and three interceptions in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett throws three interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Brissett didn't have a good game on Sunday. He was only able to hit 166 passing yards and threw three interceptions over the course of the afternoon, including a pick-six at the end of the game that secured the loss for Arizona. He won't be a good fantasy option moving forward, though he should continue to support Arizona's offensive weapons just fine.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 38-of-52 passes for 280 yards and two touchdowns in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett throws two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Brissett was able to play a complete game without any turnovers. They played from behind in the second half where they scored 24 points. Brissett also added a rushing score. He'll take on the Giants next week.

news.body: Jacoby Brissett completed 17 of 28 passes for 95 yards with a touchdown and an interception in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks.
news.head: Jacoby Brissett struggles in loss to Seattle
news.impact: Brissett did not look good in this game, failing to even crack a hundred passing yards on the day. He will try to do better against the 49ers next time out. But even that matchup is on the difficult side.

news.body: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR
news.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.

news.body: Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot.
news.head: Jalen Hurts ruled out Sunday due to superficial blood clot
news.impact: Per the Eagles, Hurts underwent an ultrasound that revealed a superficial blood clot. "On Wednesday night, a follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in the small blood clot." It will likely be Tanner McKee starting for the Eagles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Hurts (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hurts fantasy value will largely be dependant on the health of DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley. He is a risky start for fantasy managers as of now given his recent struggles.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 21 of 40 passes for 220 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Jalen Hurts tosses one touchdown in Sunday's loss
news.impact: Given the injuries in the Eagles' backfield, it was certainly surprising that Hurts only carried the ball twice for two yards in Week 5. He did make some plays with his arm, but the passing attack was inefficient overall. Hurts led what looked like a certain game-winning drive late in the fourth quarter, as the Eagles grabbed a 17-16 lead on a 48-yard FG with eight seconds remaining. However, the Jaguars were able to steal the game back with some clutch special-teams play. Hurts still has his work cut out for him in the short term, with top WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) still trying to make it back and several new faces on the offensive line. The Panthers await in Week 6.

news.body: Jameis Winston completed 14-of-26 passes for 152 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Jameis Winston gets benched Sunday
news.impact: Winston led the Giants to just 10 points in three quarters before he was benched and replaced by J.J. McCarthy in the fourth quarter. It is unclear who will start next week.

news.body: Jameis Winston completed 33-of-54 pass attempts for 326 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing five times for 27 yards in the Giants' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Jameis Winston tosses three touchdowns in Week 5 tie with Commanders
news.impact: Winston has been impactful behind center of late, passing for three touchdowns in each of the last two games. The veteran signal-caller will look to offer head coach John Harbaugh another dynamic performance in Week 6 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Jameis Winston completed 18-of-29 passing attempts for 250 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jameis Winston tosses three touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Winston struggled in his first couple of games as New York's starter, but he looked much better on Sunday and was able to throw three touchdowns while leading New York to a nice win over the Cardinals. He still threw two interceptions, which was less than ideal, but this performance at least showed that he's still capable of supporting fantasy options on this offense, which is great news. He will likely remain their starter for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Giants coach John Harbaugh confirmed Jameis Winston remains the team’s starting quarterback.
news.head: Jameis Winston to remain Giants starting QB
news.impact: Harbaugh confirmed this statement after the team traded for JJ McCarthy on Monday. Winston has struggled in two games, but he'll remain the team's starter for now.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 19-of-30 passing attempts for 271 yards and three touchdowns and added another in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jared Goff scores four touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Goff was able to lead the Lions to an easy win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He was very efficient over the course of the afternoon, racking up nearly 300 total yards and four touchdowns, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. He projects to be a quality fantasy option again in a home matchup against the Packers next week.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 32 of 52 passes for 412 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Jared Goff airs it out for 412 yards in Sunday night's loss
news.impact: Through Sunday, Goff now holds the NFL's highest single-game total in passing yards for the season. The Lions threw the ball 52 times compared to just 15 runs, leading to Goff's seventh career 400-yard passing performance. Surprisingly, the Lions' QB only connected for one touchdown pass on the night. Overall, Goff has been excellent through four weeks, completing 67.7% of his throws for better than 300 yards per game with a 9-0 TD/INT ratio.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 25-of-32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He also rushed for six yards on four carries.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 3
news.impact: Goff found Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs through the air to help pace the Lions to a home win over the Jets. Goff has yet to throw an interception this year and has three straight multi-touchdown games to open the season. The Lions will take on the Panthers on the road in Week 4.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-38 passing attempts for 327 yards and four touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jared Goff throws four touchdowns in win Thursday
news.impact: Goff and Detroit's offense struggled at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they were able to get things going later, and he ended up throwing four touchdowns in a shootout loss to the Buffalo Bills. He has looked terrific to start the season and should continue to be a safe week-to-week streaming option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 199 yards while also carrying the ball nine times for a team-high 103 yards and two touchdowns in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
news.head: Jayden Daniels dynamic on ground in Week 5 tie with Giants
news.impact: Daniels carried an otherwise underwhelming Washington offense in his return to the lineup, recording two touchdowns for the second time in his three games. The quarterback remains an electric dual-threat option behind center ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers for head coach Dan Quinn.

news.body: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports that Jayden Daniels is not "100 percent” healthy yet.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) still not '100 percent' healthy
news.impact: Daniels is still slated to play on Sunday against the Giants, but re-injury risk is a bit of a concern.

news.body: Jayden Daniels will return on Sunday against the Giants.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) will start Sunday
news.impact: It had been trending this way all week and it is now official. Daniels will not have Stefon Diggs with Terry McLaurin also being up in the air. There is some risk in his first game back with a banged up wide receiver room, but there's still plenty of upside as well.

news.body: Jayden Daniels is expected to be a "full go" in Washington's Week 5 matchup against the Giants.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) a 'full go' in Week 5
news.impact: Daniels practiced in full on Wednesday with a brace on his left (non-throwing) elbow. Terry McLaurin and/or Stefon Diggs's availability will affect Daniels' full fantasy value, as both of his primary wideouts have been dealing with injuries. However, the Giants allow 16.8 fantasy points per game to opposing quarterbacks, so if Daniels is the best QB on your roster, start him in Week 5.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 23-of-32 passing attempts for 190 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws four touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Burrow looked great on Sunday. He scored four touchdowns through the air en route to a win over the Dolphins, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. The Bengals are now heading into their bye week but he should continue to be a great fantasy option when the team is back out on the field.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 39-of-54 passing attempts for 428 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding six yards and a touchdown on the ground in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: Burrow had an up-and-down performance on Sunday. On the one hand, he was able to throw for over 425 yards and logged two total touchdowns against the Jaguars. On the other hand, he threw two interceptions and led Cincinnati to score just 17 points in a loss at home. His fantasy value for next week will heavily depend on the health of Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) for their matchup against the Dolphins.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 28-of-37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He rushed for 13 yards on two carries.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Burrow was excellent for the majority of the game Sunday, finding Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and Mike Gesicki for his three touchdown passes. The veteran did fumble on what would be the final drive for the Bengals, sealing the win for the Steelers. Burrow and the Bengals will welcome the Jaguars to town in Week 4.

news.body: Joe Burrow (back) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Joe Burrow (back) off injury report for Week 3
news.impact: Burrow was reportedly dealing with some soreness coming into the week, but it's not a serious issue and he carries no injury designation ahead of Week 3. He should be a full go against the Steelers, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 25-of-31 pass attempts for 367 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing once for six yards in the Packers' 31-7 Week 5 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jordan Love tosses two touchdowns in Week 5 win over Bears
news.impact: Love has flashed impactful output behind center, passing for over 300 yards in three of the first five contests. The quarterback will look to take advantage of a generous Dallas Cowboys defense in Week 6.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 22 of his 30 passes for 197 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Jordan Love throws two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Love turned in a solid game in the close win over Tampa Bay. His touchdown passes went to Tucker Kraft and Matthew Golden. Love has now thrown for 1,041 yards, eight touchdowns, and three interceptions through four games. He will be a high-end QB2 heading into Week 5's matchup against the Bears.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 28 of 53 passes for 312 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons. He also ran once for no gain.
news.head: Jordan Love passes for 312 yards in loss
news.impact: Love was a bit up and down in this game. He was struggling against the pressure Atlanta was bringing, missing several forced throws and causing tipped passes. The Green Bay offense has no run game, which has worked out decently well for the pass catchers, but until they get things going on the ground to make the defense respect the run, it will be hard for the receivers and Love to have a ceiling week in, week out.

news.body: Jordan Love told reporters that his elbow injury is a non-issue for Week 3 against the Falcons.
news.head: Jordan Love says elbow is non-issue for Week 3
news.impact: Love said discomfort in his elbow went away before Jets game ended. He indicated the elbow is a non-issue for the Falcons game, even on a short week.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 12 of his 19 passes for 210 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 121 yards and a rushing touchdown on the ground in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Josh Allen rushes for 121 yards, TD in Week 5 win
news.impact: Allen didn't have his best passing game but he dominated the Rams on the ground in the thrilling Monday night win as he easily set a season-high in rushing yards. His lone touchdown pass went to Keon Coleman in the third quarter. Allen has thrown for 1,249 yards, seven touchdowns, and four interceptions through five games this season. He will remain a top-three fantasy quarterback heading into Week 6 against the Raiders.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passes for 254 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the loss to the Patriots. He rushed for four yards and a touchdown on five carries.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for two touchdowns in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Allen turned in a solid day Sunday, including a touchdown pass to Keon Coleman late in the game. Allen was without DJ Moore, who left the game in the first half with a shoulder injury. His interception late in the game ended up a comeback and handed the Bills their first loss of the season. Allen and the Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Josh Allen is without an injury designation ahead of Week 4's matchup against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Josh Allen without injury designation for Week 4
news.impact: There was some concern that Allen suffered a minor injury of some kind in last week's win over the Chargers, but that's not the case and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 4. He should be a full go and remains a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 16-of-26 pass attempts for 204 yards and two interceptions while also rushing eight times for 22 yards and two touchdowns with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Josh Allen reaches end zone on ground twice in Week 3 win over Chargers
news.impact: Allen made up for a mistake-filled day behind center rushing for two touchdowns for the third consecutive contests. The quarterback remains locked in as an elite dual-threat option behind center in all formats, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 22 of 37 passes for 204 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception while rushing five times for 26 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Justin Herbert Held Without Touchdown in Week 6
news.impact: Herbert couldn't get much going against Kansas City's defense, averaging just 5.5 yards per attempt while taking four sacks. His 26 rushing yards helped some, but Los Angeles failed to score a touchdown for the first time this season. Herbert's combination of a struggling offense and shaky protection makes him difficult to trust as more than a QB2 in Superflex leagues right now.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed just 14 of 24 passes for 121 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 54 yards on six carries in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Justin Herbert effective with legs, less so with arm in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Herbert and the Chargers' passing attack continue to flounder this season. Five games in, Herbert has yet to reach even 1,000 passing yards and has thrown more interceptions (7) than touchdowns (5). He's taken to the ground for a combined 94 yards on a dozen carries over the last two weeks, but that's not made up for poor passing. Herbert is not a recommended start going into Kansas City next week.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 19-of-31 passes for 189 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks on Sunday.
news.head: Justin Herbert continues to struggle Sunday
news.impact: Herbert added 40 yards rushing on the ground. He threw a pair of interceptions to linebackers, including on the first offensive play of the game. He remains someone tough to trust heading into a matchup against the Broncos next week.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 20-of-34 pass attempts for 226 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing four times for 17 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Justin Herbert struggles again behind center in Week 3 loss to Bills
news.impact: Herbert has struggled to make an impact behind center to begin the season, finishing with less than 230 passing yards in each of the first three contests. The quarterback will look to break out of his early season struggles as part of an underperforming Chargers offense against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 4.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 19-of-28 passes for 243 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders loss to the Patriots Sunday.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses one touchdown in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Cousins completed his lone touchdown pass to Brock Bowers in the first quarter, and then the Raiders offense struggled to get anything going from there. Cousins and the Raiders will return home and take on the Bills in Week 6.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 31 of his 52 passes for 365 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4. He also completed a two-point conversion pass to Cody White.
news.head: Kirk Cousins throws two TDs in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Cousins put up big numbers in the close loss but he couldn't quite knock off the Chiefs. His touchdown passes went to Brock Bowers and Ian Thomas in the contest. Cousins has looked reinvigorated for the Raiders this season, throwing for 1,026 yards, 11 touchdowns, and four interceptions through four games. He will be a high-end QB2 in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 22-of-33 passes for 248 yards with three touchdowns in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Kirk Cousins throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Cousins enjoyed the return of Brock Bowers in a big way Sunday afternoon as the two connected on 10 passes for 116 yards and a touchdown. Cousins also threw touchdowns to Michael Mayer and Cody White. He'll face the Chiefs next week.

news.body: Kirk Cousins completed 19-of-29 passing attempts for 253 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Kirk Cousins tosses three touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Cousins played a good game on Sunday. He threw three touchdowns over the course of the day and he led Las Vegas to a big win over their divisional rivals. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option himself moving forward but should be good enough to support at least two fantasy options on this offense on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 24-of-30 pass attempts for 229 yards and one touchdown while also rushing 10 times for 51 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Kyler Murray steady in Week 5 win over Saints
news.impact: Murray has struggled to make an impact behind center early in the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, passing for less than 250 yards in each of his four contests. The dual-threat signal caller remains difficult for fantasy managers to trust as the Vikings enter their bye week.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 27-of-37 passing attempts for 247 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Kyler Murray scoreless in win Sunday
news.impact: Murray took care of the ball on Sunday, but he wasn't able to get much going against the Dolphins and didn't score a touchdown during the team's win. He shouldn't be considered a good fantasy option moving forward, especially if Justin Jefferson (ankle) has to miss more time.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 15-of-29 passes for 168 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray has underwhelming day Sunday
news.impact: Murray was playing in his first game back from the concussion protocol. He lost Justin Jefferson early for the day. He targeted Jordan Addison heavily, including on a 41-yard touchdown. He'll face the Dolphins next week.

news.body: Kyler Murray has cleared concussion protocol and will start against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start Week 3
news.impact: Murray missed the Vikings Week 2 slog of a win over the Bears, but he will be back in the lineup for Week 3 against a hapless Tampa defense. Murray is still a bit of an unknown at this point given he barely played in Week 1, but this is a perfect matchup to return to.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 6 for the Baltimore Ravens according to Brian Wacker.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Week 6
news.impact: Jackson will be sidelined for the second consecutive game with the ankle injury for head coach Jesse Minter after being unable to practice to this point, with backup Tyler Huntley to start behind center against the Cleveland Browns Sunday.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (toe) is not practicing for the Baltimore Ravens Friday according to Jamison Hensley.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Jackson finishes the practice week without taking the field for head coach Jesse Minter, pointing towards backup Tyler Huntley receiving another start behind center against the Cleveland Browns Sunday.

news.body: Lamar Jackson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) not at practice Thursday
news.impact: Jackson will likely have to practice in some fashion on Friday to have a chance to return this week. Otherwise, Tyler Huntley will be in line to see another start.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially did not take part in Baltimore's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Jackson was a non-participant at practice to start the week on Wednesday. He's still recovering from an ankle injury that left him sidelined last week, and it may very well leave him sidelined for another game in Week 6. Tyler Huntley will get another start for the Ravens if that's the case, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 40 of his 54 pass attempts for 383 yards and three touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Matthew Stafford throws three TDs in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Stafford turned in a huge game in the Monday night loss to Buffalo, but he couldn't put any points on the board in overtime. The veteran quarterback threw two touchdown passes to Davante Adams, while his third went to Puka Nacua. Stafford has now thrown for 1,572 yards, nine touchdowns, and six interceptions through five games. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 32-of-51 passing attempts for 317 yards and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Matthew Stafford doesn't score in win Sunday
news.impact: Stafford was able to lead the Rams to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to find a lot of personal success in the process. He failed to score even a single touchdown in this matchup, and he also threw two interceptions, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back and return to form sometime in the near future, however,

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 30-of-55 passing attempts for 390 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 13 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Matthew Stafford totals 403 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stafford had an up-and-down game on Sunday night. He finished with over 400 total yards and two touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. He made some mistakes that opened the door for Denver to win this game, but fantasy managers should be happy with his production and should continue to start him in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 22-of-31 passing attempts for 327 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses four touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: The reigning MVP had a great bounce-back game on Monday night after a disappointing season opener last week. He scored four touchdowns against the Giants and limited his mistakes overall, helping lead Los Angeles to a blowout win over New York. The only questions for him moving forward will be consistency and the health of his wideouts, with Puka Nacua (hip) currently out of the lineup for the Rams.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. completed 19-of-33 pass attempts for 225 yards and three touchdowns while rushing once for one yard and losing a fumble in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Penix Jr. has been mostly reliable behind center in his return to the lineup, throwing for one or more touchdowns in each of his last three contests. The quarterback remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) is off of the Falcons injury report and will play on Sunday against the Bears.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) off injury report, will play Sunday
news.impact: Penix was on the injury report most of the week with a ribs injury but looks good to go against the Bears. He doesn’t have a super high ceiling, and he’s hovered around low-end QB2 territory since returning from injury, but against the Bears soft defense, he could put up a usable performance this week.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: Penix was able to practice in full for a second-straight day on Thursday, squarely putting him on track to start in Week 6. Assuming he suffers no setbacks, fantasy managers should expect him to play, which is the best outcome for the fantasy value of players like Bijan Robinson and Drake London this week.

news.body: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Penix injured his ribs last week, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and told reporters that he will be 'good to play' this week. He should be available to start for the Falcons, which is great news for the fantasy value of Drake London, Bijan Robinson, and all of Atlanta's skill-position players this week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception while adding 16 yards on five carries in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes Throws for 272 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Mahomes moved the ball efficiently at 9.1 yards per attempt, but Kenneth Walker III scored both of Kansas City's touchdowns on the ground. The interception didn't help, either, leaving Mahomes with a disappointing fantasy performance despite the Chiefs putting up 422 total yards. There isn't much to overthink here -- Mahomes remains a high-end QB1 going forward.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 15 of his 30 passes for 225 yards and two touchdowns in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II throws two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Mahomes managed to hold off an upstart Raiders squad that gave the Chiefs everything they could handle. Both of his touchdown passes went to Tyquan Thornton in the win. Mahomes has now thrown for 1,037 yards, nine touchdowns, and two interceptions through four games. He will be on bye in Week 5 before going up against the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 20-of-24 pass attempts for 246 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing once for one yard in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses two touchdowns in Week 3 win
news.impact: Mahomes II continues a dynamic start to the season behind center, posting two or more touchdowns in each of the first three games. The superstar quarterback has turned back the clock for head coach Andy Reid to begin the season, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 32-of-47 passing attempts for 382 yards and three touchdowns while adding 17 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Mahomes had an electric game on Sunday night, throwing three touchdowns and totaling nearly 400 yards en route to a narrow win over the Colts. He has been terrific since his return from injury and should be considered a worthwhile starter with week-to-week upside on any given week.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 27-of-51 passes for 278 yards and two interceptions in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also ran twice for 19 yards.
news.head: Sam Darnold struggles in loss to Denver
news.impact: It was not a good night for Darnold, whose performance led to questions of benching, which HC Mike MacDonald quickly shut down. Darnold is still the Seahawks starter, but more will be asked and expected of him in the coming weeks as Seattle looks to right the ship.

news.body: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said he is not considering benching Sam Darnold.
news.head: Sam Darnold not considering being benched per HC Mike Macdonald
news.impact: This comes one day after Darnold threw two more interceptions in a close loss where the Seahawks defense dominated. He is now up to seven interceptions on the season despite missing essentially the first two weeks where Lock played well and took care of the ball. It appears Darnold will remain the quarterback in Week 7 against the Chiefs.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 18-of-29 passes for 195 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Sam Darnold struggles Sunday
news.impact: Darnold faced pressure all afternoon as he was sacked five times. He began both the game and second half with interceptions as well. He'll take on Denver on a short week on Thursday.

news.body: Sam Darnold completed 13-of-22 passes for 168 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Sam Darnold throws two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Darnold threw an interception on the Seahawks first offensive play of the game. He didn't seem to be comfortable in the pocket for most of the afternoon. He'll be a QB2 next week against the 49ers.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence clears 300 yards for the first time this season
news.impact: Lawrence not only passed for a new season-high in yards Sunday, but he also gained 25 yards on the ground for the second time through the first five weeks. Lawrence is averaging just under 235 passing yards per game on the campaign, with a 67.1% completion rate and a 10-3 TD/INT ratio. He'll face the division-rival Texans in Week 6, and remains a definite QB1.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 18-of-23 passing attempts for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence was able to lead the Jaguars to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to rack up many fantasy points in the process, finishing with just one touchdown over the course of the afternoon. Almost all of Jacksonville's fantasy options disappointed in this matchup, but they should be able to bounce back in a competitive matchup against the Eagles next week.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 19-of-29 passing attempts for 182 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while adding 25 yards on the ground in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses three touchdowns in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence played a stellar game on Sunday, finishing with over 200 total yards and three touchdowns in a big win over the Patriots. He has been playing well so far this season and will continue to be a viable starting option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite still dealing with a hand issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and this issue shouldn't play a big factor for fantasy managers when they weigh whether or not to start him against the Giants this week.

news.body: Saints QB Tyler Shough is reportedly playing through a hand injury.
news.head: Tyler Shough playing through hand injury
news.impact: Saints head coach Kellen Moore was asked directly whether Shough's hand is broken. "It got banged two weeks ago and he's just wearing some protective layers there," he said. It doesn't appear Shough is in danger of missing any time, but he'll need to be monitored on the injury report this week.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. carried the ball 25 times for 113 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all three of his targets for four yards in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. leads ground attack in Week 5 win over Saints
news.impact: Jones Sr. has been impactful out of the Minnesota backfield of late, surpassing 90 offensive yards in each of the last four games. The veteran running back offers head coach Kevin O'Connell one of the few reliable offensive options as the Vikings enter their Week 6 bye.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) is questionable to return for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints Sunday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Jones Sr. carried the ball seven times for 28 yards with a fumble lost while also catching his only target for one yard prior to suffering the injury. Demond Claiborne will take over in the backfield for head coach Kevin O’Connell against the Saints.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Jones gets a rest day to begin the week. He remains a steady RB2 while Jordan Mason is sidelined.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed the ball 20 times for 94 yards and caught 4-of-8 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. totals 128 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran played well on Sunday. He logged 128 total yards against the Dolphins, and he was able to do that while maintaining good efficiency. He will continue to be a worthwhile fantasy option for however long Jordan Mason (thumb) remains out of the lineup for the Vikings.

news.body: Alvin Kamara ran for 34 yards on seven carries in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 35 yards receiving and a touchdown.
news.head: Alvin Kamara hauls in receiving touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The big play on the day for Kamara was a 31-yard catch and run for a touchdown where the Giants missed multiple tackles. He'll be on the flex radar next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Kamara was considered questionable to play after being limited in practice throughout the week. Kamara is likely a flex play at best in deeper leagues right now.

news.body: Alvin Kamara has been listed questionable for Sunday’s game against the Giants.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Kamara was limited in practice throughout the week. He will be a borderline flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (back) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: Kamara was able to practice in a limited fashion again on Thursday, though he's still dealing with a nagging back issue. He should play through it in Week 6 but doesn't project to be the bellcow back for the team for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Ashton Jeanty is starting to “feel a lot better” physically.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty 'feeling a lot better physically' per Klint Kubiak
news.impact: There had been rumors of the Raiders potentially having Jeanty sit a week to get fully healthy. When asked if the team considered sitting Jeanty to get him healthy, Kubiak said, “he’s playing.”

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for 27 yards on 10 carries in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. He caught 3-of-6 targets for 50 yards in the loss.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty struggles in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Jeanty entered the game questionable with an ankle/foot injury, which could have led to his struggles against the Patriots. Jeanty will look to bounce back in Week 6 against the Bills.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) is active for Week 5 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) active for Week 5
news.impact: Jeanty is good to go after testing his injured foot and ankle during pregame warmups, offering head coach Klint Kubiak is dynamic backfield option against the Patriots Sunday.

news.body: Austin Ekeler was wearing a non-contact jersey during practice on Friday.
news.head: Austin Ekeler (chest) in non-contact jersey in practice Friday
news.impact: Ekeler was limited in practice on Thursday where he also wore a non-contact jersey. He'll have one more day to practice on Saturday.

news.body: Austin Ekeler (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Austin Ekeler (chest) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice on Thursday, but he was limited due to a chest injury that he's managing. He should be available to play on Monday night still and will see more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is sidelined against San Francisco.

news.body: Austin Ekeler rushed three times for a loss of one yard while also catching his only target for 15 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
news.head: Austin Ekeler sees four touches in Week 5
news.impact: Ekeler has seen minimal involvement since signing with the Commanders, logging five touches or less in each of his two contests. The veteran running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Austin Ekeler is active for Week 4 for the Washington Commanders against the Indianapolis Colts according to John Keim.
news.head: Austin Ekeler active for Week 4
news.impact: Ekeler will suit up after being unable being signed to the active roster earlier in the week, with the veteran running back looking to make an impact out of the Washington backfield behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Kaytron Allen with Rachaad White sidelined for head coach Dan Quinn against the Colts.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed for 39 yards on 12 carries in the 34-31 loss to the Texans. He caught 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten hits pay dirt twice in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Tuten did have a rushing touchdown called back on a holding call, limiting his rushing output. His two touchdowns receptions marked his first receiving touchdowns of the season, and is a good sign for him being more involved in the passing game in the future. Tuten and the Jaguars will head to the bye in Week 7.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed for 72 yards on 22 carries, adding two receptions for 24 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten approaches 100 yards of total offense Sunday
news.impact: Tuten continues to prove he can shoulder the load out of the Jaguars' backfield. The second-year pro only averaged 3.3 yards on his career-high 22 carries Sunday, but he seemed to run stronger as the game progressed. For the season, Tuten is averaging 70 yards on more than 16 carries per game with a couple of touchdowns. He's a solid RB2 with upside in most fantasy formats.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed the ball 17 times for 73 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten racks up 91 yards in win Sunday
news.impact: Tuten had a good game on Sunday, finishing as the team's top rusher and dominating the touches in the backfield en route to a win over the Bengals. Chris Rodriguez Jr. was the one to get into the end zone for the Jaguars, however, which was annoying for fantasy managers to see. The young running back should continue to be a worthwhile fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed the ball 15 times for 73 yards and caught two passes for 17 yards in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Tuten had a good game on Sunday. He led the team in rushing yards at an efficient clip of 4.9 yards per carry, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a great fantasy total. He should again be started in a matchup against the Bengals next week.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball nine times for 61 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of eight yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Bijan Robinson bottled up in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Robinson struggled to make an impact out of the backfield, recording less than 70 offensive yards for the first time in six contests. The running back remains locked in as a strong RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Bijan Robinson gained 86 yards on 17 carries and caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Bijan Robinson totals 118 yards on 21 touches in Week 5
news.impact: Robinson continues to be one of the elite offensive weapons in the league, as the dual-threat back is averaging 116 rushing yards and more than 30 receiving yards per game this season. Robinson scored twice on the ground in both Week 3 and Week 4, but he couldn't keep the TD streak going Sunday night against the Ravens. He will look to start a new one in Week 6 against the Bears.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed the ball 19 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Bijan Robinson dominant in blowout win Monday
news.impact: Robinson was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He led the Falcons in rushing with 145 yards on the night at a hyper-efficient clip of 7.6 yards per carry, and he was also able to get into the end zone on two separate occasions. He let a little to be desired in the passing game, but that was simply because the Falcons were up so much for so long. He has been stellar over the first four weeks of the season and should continue to be one of the best assets in all of fantasy moving forward.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran 29 times for 194 yards and two touchdowns and caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.
news.head: Bijan Robinson explodes in Week 3 win over Packers
news.impact: Robinson had his way with the Packers' defense, rushing for 6.7 yards per carry. He ripped off a huge 55-yard gain early on in the game, which opened the floodgates for many more big runs throughout the game. The Packers simply could not stop him, and once the ground game got going, QB Michael Penix and WR Drake London were able to carve up the Packers' secondary. With Penix back, the offense has new life, and Bijan stands to benefit greatly from it, even if Brian Robinson Jr. spells him.

news.body: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball five times for 14 yards and caught one pass for seven yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Blake Corum a non-factor in win Sunday
news.impact: Corum didn't play much of a role for the Rams in Week 4. He saw just six touches over the course of the game and was only able to turn them into 21 yards, as opposed to Kyren Williams' 26 touches for 147 yards. Fantasy managers shouldn't have much hope for Corum to have standalone value anytime soon.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball six times for 15 yards and caught 2-of-4 targets for zero yards in Sunday's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Blake Corum quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Corum wasn't able to contribute much on Sunday. He totaled just 15 yards on his ten opportunities over the course of the night, which left him with a very poor fantasy total. He will continue to see a good amount of work in Los Angeles' offense moving forward but will likely continue to fall behind Kyren Williams in competitive matchups.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball 12 times for 79 yards and caught one pass for 13 yards in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Blake Corum totals 92 yards in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' offense looked great on Monday night, and Corum was no exception to that. He put up 92 total yards on just 13 opportunities, although he wasn't able to get into the endzone to put the capstone on that. The Rams' backfield is a situation to continue monitoring, with Corum and Kyren Williams each seeing the same amount of carries in this blowout win.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 78 yards on 17 carries in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for 26 yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees 19 touches in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Allen continued to see the bulk of the carries for the Jets with Breece Hall (quad) out injured. Fantasy managers should expect Allen to continue to operate as the Jets' RB1 if Hall is not cleared to return against Miami next week.

news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 24 times for 116 yards and a touchdown while catching one of his four targets for no gain in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Braelon Allen finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: Allen looked excellent on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. He ripped off an impressive 22-yard touchdown run to put the Jets up for good in the fourth quarter. Allen will be on the RB2 radar in Week 6 against the Patriots.

news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 14 times for 59 yards while catching both of his targets for eight yards in a 23-12 loss to the Bears in Week 4.
news.head: Braelon Allen runs for 59 yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Allen got all of the backfield touches but wasn't able to do much with them, averaging just 4.2 yards per carry in the loss. With Breece Hall (quad) looking at least another week or two away from returning, Allen should operate as the Jets' lead back again in Week 5 against the Browns.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 14 yards on four carries in the 31-24 loss to the Lions. He caught all three of his targets for three yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen tallies seven touches in Week 3
news.impact: Allen continued to see limited work Sunday, but he could be in line for more touches in Week 4 if Breece Hall (thigh) misses time. Hall was injured late in the game and will likely undergo testing Monday to determine the severity of the injury.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) will not play in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out for Week 6
news.impact: Hall will miss a third straight game due to a quad injury. Braelon Allen will shoulder the load out of the Jets' backfield once again in Week 6.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) was officially a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) officially a non-participant Thursday
news.impact: Hall was seen working with trainers off to the side at practice on Thursday, but he wasn't able to take part in any official drills and ended up being a non-participant. Fantasy managers should expect him to be sidelined for at least one more game, which will lead to more work for Braelon Allen against the Patriots.

news.body: Breece Hall was working with trainers on a side field during practice on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) working with trainers on side field
news.impact: It is a step in the right direction for Hall. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: To no surprise, Hall was not able to practice on Wednesday. He's still managing a quad injury and is currently considered week-to-week. It looks like Braelon Allen will again be the starter for the Jets this week, which will give him potential flex value for this game at least.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. rushed twice for one yard while also catching both of his targets for nine yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. sees four touches in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Robinson Jr. has fallen back to earth of late, recording less than 20 offensive yards in each of the last two games. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. gained just 16 yards on seven carries in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. bottled up by Ravens in Week 5
news.impact: A week after scoring three times on the ground, Robinson had his weakest output of the season in Sunday's loss. He managed just 2.3 yards per carry with a long of four against the Ravens. Brian Robinson will look to get back on track in his complementary role behind Bijan Robinson in Week 6 against the Bears.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. rushed the ball 14 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 45-24 blowout win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. scored three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Robinson had one of the best games of his careers in Week 4, scoring three touchdowns en route to a blowout win over Atlanta's divisional rivals on Monday night. He was able to tack on 62 yards outside of that, and he should be considered one of the premier handcuff options in fantasy at this point, as he has week-to-week upside even with Bijan Robinson healthy and starting ahead of him for the Falcons.

news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. ran 10 times for 50 yards and a touchdown in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.
news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. runs in touchdown in big win
news.impact: Robinson played second fiddle to Bijan Robinson, but he still got enough touches and some goal-line work that he was usable for those who started him. He's been splitting work with Bijan to keep the younger back rested, and he won't have outings like this all the time, but he's certainly a handcuff worth rostering.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 yards and a touchdown, as well as catching two passes for 10 additional yards and a score in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Bucky Irving rumbles for 165 yards in win over Dallas
news.impact: Irving struggled to get going in this game, but finished off the Bucs' first drive with a touchdown catch. He then started to see holes open up in the defensive line as the game went on and made Dallas pay for it. He did cede a goal-line touch to Sean Tucker, but Tucker was ruled short of the plane on his attempt to punch in a score. Bucky has been a bit up and down so far this year, but in the right matchup, he's certainly a strong start.

news.body: Bucky Irving carried the ball 16 times for 61 yards in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Bucky Irving goes for 61 yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: He was not targeted in the passing game. Irving dealt with a glute injury throughout the week, but he did not seem affected by it during the game. He did watch as fellow running backs Kenny Gainwell and Sean Tucker both found the end zone in the close loss. Irving has run for 241 yards and one touchdown through four games this season. He will be on the RB2 radar in Week 5 against the Cowboys.

news.body: Bucky Irving is officially good to go for Sunday's game against the Packers.
news.head: Bucky Irving (glute) good to go Sunday
news.impact: Irving sat on the bench for the majority of the fourth quarter last week. He was limited in practice throughout the week and will be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Bucky Irving (glute) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (glute) officially limited Thursday
news.impact: Irving has been limited in two-straight practices to start the week. He's still managing a glute injury, but it looks more likely than not that he will play through it this week. If he's cleared to play heading into the weekend, fantasy managers should have no hesitations starting him in a matchup against the Packers.

news.body: Cam Skattebo did not see a carry in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo does not see a carry Sunday
news.impact: There were reports of a potential benching for Skattebo with his recent fumble issues. He did not see a carry and was on the field for just a handful of snaps. His role will be uncertain heading into next week against the Texans.

news.body: Cam Skattebo rushed 13 times for 59 yards while also catching two of his three targets for 12 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Cam Skattebo leads backfield in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Skattebo has been mostly steady out of the New York backfield to this point, rushing for over 55 yards in four of five contests. The running back will look for an impactful performance in a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Cam Skattebo told reporters he will play on Sunday against the Commanders.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Skattebo said he had a "little muscle tightness" in his shoulder. It's why he wore a red no-contact jersey on Wednesday. He'll remain a steady RB2 play.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) was limited at New York's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Skattebo was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He's still dealing with a shoulder issue of some kind and is likely considered day-to-day for the time being. It looks likely that he will play in Week 5, and he will have a good opportunity to put up some real fantasy points this week in a favorable matchup against the Commanders.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 13 times for 39 yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Chase Brown underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: The young running back wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He totaled 50 yards over his 17 opportunities, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy total. He should bounce back and look better after Cincinnati's bye week this week, but his production may continue to be inconsistent moving forward.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball nine times for ten yards and hauled in 11 catches for 71 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Chase Brown hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Brown was very ineffective as a rusher on Sunday, finishing with just ten yards in a loss to the Jaguars. He was able to contribute heavily through the passing game, however, logging 71 yards on a whopping 11 catches. The Bengals may need to lean on him in the passing game again next week with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at risk to be sidelined against the Dolphins.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 61 yards on 13 carries in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
news.head: Chase Brown quiet in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Brown saw a season low in rushing attempts and targets. Despite the lower volume against Pittsburgh, fantasy managers should expect Brown to remain the workhorse running back for the Bengals in Week 4 against the Jaguars.

news.body: Chase Brown ran for 80 yards on 20 carries in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-5 targets for two yards receiving.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 20 carries Sunday
news.impact: Brown did not find the end zone. He ran well, but it was still a fairly quiet day for him overall for fantasy managers. He'll remain an RB1 against the Steelers next week.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. rushed for 55 yards on 11 carries in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to Houston. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. sees 11 carries in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Rodriguez tallied a better yards per carry average than Bhayshul Tuten, but Tuten was able to get more involved in the passing game. Fantasy managers should expect Tuten to continue to see the bulk of the playing time coming out of the Week 7 bye.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. gained five yards on two carries and caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. does little with three touches in Sunday's win
news.impact: This was the least that Rodriguez has been involved in the offense so far through five games. The fourth-year pro has been valuable as the short-yardage back for the Jaguars this season, averaging slightly over 4.0 yards per carry with a couple of touchdowns on his 28 carries to this point. He should see more touches than this most weeks, but his fantasy value is mostly limited to being a handcuff for starter Bhayshul Tuten right now.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. rushed the ball six times for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Rodriguez was able to contribute on Sunday, finishing with a touchdown in the team's narrow win over the Bengals. He saw 13 less opportunities than Bhayshul Tuten over the course of the afternoon, however, so he will clearly continue to be a depth contributor for the Jaguars for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. rushed the ball eight times for 37 times and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Rodriguez was clearly the RB2 for the Jaguars on Sunday, but he was still able to contribute quite effectively for them with 37 yards and a touchdown on just eight carries. Still, his current workload won't be enough to offer any sustained fantasy success anytime soon.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey (rest) was absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (rest) absent from practice Thursday
news.impact: Thursday was San Francisco's first practice of the week, so to no surprise, they gave McCaffrey the day off as a veteran rest day. He should be back on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Monday night's game against the Washington Commanders.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 15 yards receiving.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey continues to find the end zone to make up for his lack of yardage on the season. He scored right after a fumble by Emanuel Wilson this week. He remains an RB1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey rushed 15 times for 52 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his five targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey didn't have his biggest day from a yardage standpoint, but he found the end zone on a one-yard run in the fourth quarter. He finished with 18 touches and remains the clear lead back in San Francisco. McCaffrey remains a must-start option heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran for 75 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He also caught 4-of-5 targets for 41 yards receiving.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey took over as the clear lead back on Sunday. He found the end zone in the fourth quarter as the Cardinals were making a comeback. He remains a strong RB1 moving forward.

news.body: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard recorded 120 yards on 28 carries and caught one pass for one yard, punching in a rushing touchdown in a Week 6 win over Philadelphia.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard totals 120 yards, score vs. Eagles
